caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP IC90 REP rows are preserved as source_conflict because Table 1 reports percent inhibition at 10 µM, not a primary IC90 endpoint.

linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty; peptide sequences are source-verified from paper Table 1 and linked DRAMP/DBAASP identity rows instead.
The primary paper reports Vero-E6/Calu-3 cytotoxicity but not hemolysis; no hemolysis value is fabricated.
